items.name: use-finstack
items.docs: Browser-only shared worker and complete immutable queries. Wrap with FinstackQueryProvider, or FinstackProvider inside an existing QueryClientProvider. Worker and hooks follow the consumer source directory; the consumer owns its standard @/* source alias. Keep the matching local WASM package installed.

items.name: use-linked-selection
items.docs: React-only accepted string identity, controlled or locally owned. Pass null to clear; use stable supplied keys. Activation and focus are separate. The consumer owns its standard @/* source alias.

items.name: use-instrument-validator
items.docs: Native SchemaForm validation using the existing FinstackProvider worker. Returns canonical JSON and rejects superseded revisions; does not write canonical output into active edits.

items.name: use-cashflows
items.docs: Original native cashflow JSON with complete immutable request/session keys and native errors. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider. No cashflow rows or financial logic are inferred.

items.name: use-market-validator
items.docs: Canonicalize complete markets through the shared native worker. Aborted validations never replace active edits.

items.name: use-fx-delta-samples
items.docs: Native FX delta-surface evaluation with complete immutable quote/coordinate/forward keys. Null means no sampling request. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; returns annualized Black decimal volatilities or native errors.

items.name: use-cube-samples
items.docs: Checked native cube evaluation with complete SABR/forward/interpolation/coordinate/convention query keys. Null disables sampling. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; no local model calculation or clamping.

items.name: use-calibrate
items.docs: Full-envelope native calibration, static diagnostics and canonical validation through FinstackQueryProvider. Null disables a request; exact envelope and worker session own query identity. Structured native errors and complete result fields are preserved.
